_meta.role: Engenheiro | Embedded Linux (Eletrónica e Sistemas Embebidos)

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology, with a B.E. in Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering. Builds embedded Linux systems and custom hardware end to end — deploying systemd-managed Linux services on Jetson and Raspberry Pi platforms, designing and fabricating PCBs in EAGLE, and programming bare-metal C on STM32 microcontrollers. Comfortable with C/C++ and Python across firmware, application, and test-plan development.

Linux Administration: systemd service management (unit files, auto-restart, non-root isolation)

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Architected a Mixed Reality headset concept using AI-based real-time chroma keying without a green screen; produced full claims documentation and BOM.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.
Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.
Organized 10+ exhibitions and technical workshops covering Arduino, PCB design, and SolidWorks.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service (auto-restart with backoff, non-root user/group isolation, environment-file-based config) with static IP networking for reliable multi-device WebSocket registration; configured XRDP for remote desktop administration of the headless Jetson.
Implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++; drove five servos with range-gated contact detection.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to STM32 over UART.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.

projects.name: Haptics Research Study Controller — Embedded Rig + PyQt6 Host
bullets: Built a 36-trial state machine with hold/resume across USB dropouts, crash-safe queued logging of a 10 Hz temperature trace, and end-to-end tests against a simulated board; shipped Windows and macOS builds with PyInstaller.
Moved the host safety cutoff into a dedicated serial QThread; added command-level reliability with echo matching, a 400 ms ACK timeout, 3 retries, and brown-out reset detection.

awards: 1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
